notes:
Beta of 1.1.4: single-track audio analysis on the Now Playing page — three cards (Dynamics / Audio Quality / Lossless Check) folded at L0/L1/L2, an independent true peak in dBTP (4x oversampling), auto analysis off by default with per-track dedup and cancel-on-track-change, "N/A" instead of 0 when a metric cannot be measured, and an 11-point smoothed envelope for version-comparison alignment.
1.1.4 预发布：单曲页新增音频分析面板（动态 / 音质 / 假无损三张卡，L0/L1/L2 三级折叠），独立真峰 dBTP（4× 过采样），自动分析默认关闭（每曲去重、切歌取消），测不出的指标显示「不适用」而不是 0；版本对比改用 11 点平滑包络对齐。
